claims.statement: The company sees an overall store opportunity of approximately 1,800 stores across the country.
claims.quote: So, 2,200 is approximately the number of stores, out of which 400 something is what we already have. So, 1,800 approximately is the opportunity.

claims.statement: More stores will be opened in Uttar Pradesh compared to Odisha due to existing inventory and locations.
claims.quote: Possible to do both states, but we'll see more stores in UP for obvious reasons. We have inventory there. We have acquired some locations there.

facts.statement: The company operates seven pharmacy stores currently.
facts.quote: We have started. We have seven pharmacy stores now operational and encouraging results.

facts.statement: Transportation costs have increased due to a significant rise in home delivery services for DMart Ready.
facts.quote: transportation costs have increased because home delivery has significantly increased.
